'''Toril''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Toril agreed with [[Rudd (Cynabar's Droid Datalog)|Rudd]] that the [[PackTrack 41LT-R]] was a useful tool to carry equipment.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
